description.zh: 所有会使用到白板应用的客户网站域名，多个使用英文逗号(,)分隔，最多传10个。
description.en: The domain names of all customer websites that use the whiteboard application. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 domain names.

description.zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取白板应用ID，请参见[CreateApp](~~204234~~)。
description.en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the whiteboard application ID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).

title.zh: 设置白板应用合法域名
title.en: Set authorized domain names for a whiteboard application

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明

- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateApp](~~204234~~)创建白板应用。
- 目前互动白板控制台还未正式上线，请通过互动白板服务端SDK进行白板应用的相关操作。

# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342798~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes

- Before invoking this operation, you must have already created a whiteboard application by invoking [CreateApp](~~204234~~).
- The Interactive Whiteboard console is not yet officially online. Use the Interactive Whiteboard server SDK to perform related operations on whiteboard applications.

# QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Invoke this operation appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342798~~).
